summary: The dropped-list --select hint gives a working dotted selector and only fires when a requested name lives in the rows; search truncation reports the source's declared total, also as `totale` in the envelope.
reason: The hint told users to add `numero` and `titolo`, which never open the list, and fired on `get` commands for lists nobody asked for. The truncation hint hid a total the portal already sends in the session page, and its `--limit 50` example could not cover larger result sets.
validated_outcome: stdout of --select is unchanged. Live: `interrogazioni cerca --firmatario Giambona --data 2024-09-01:2024-09-30` says 10 di 24 and `--limit 24` reaches n. 1251; without --data it says 10 di 1259 and proposes no --limit; no `totale` on /bd/, split ranges and aggregated leggi. Unit test confirms no extra request.
